title: Jamaican Frittata
description: A Caribbean-inspired breakfast dish made with eggs, spices, and a hint of Jamaican jerk seasoning.

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: Hard-boiled eggs not required, but can be used as an ingredient

instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork. Add the Jamaican jerk seasoning and mix well.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and let it cook for 2-3 minutes, until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, until the frittata is cooked through.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro, scallions, and shredded cheese (if using).
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the frittata from the skillet.
Slide the frittata onto a plate and serve hot.
Optional: Top with additional chopped cilantro, scallions, or shredded cheese, if desired.
Cut the frittata into wedges and serve immediately.
